dialogues.speaker: Rashnu
dialogues.text: To wake me only for something so important... I have already forgiven her.

dialogues.speaker: Rashnu
dialogues.text: The credit for extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha belongs to Sorush... along with all those that helped her.

dialogues.speaker: Rashnu
dialogues.text: Though the situation might not be as she expected, I think the present circumstances are better.
